content: nomic-embed-text-v1.5 requires task instruction prefixes. search_query: for user queries, search_document: for indexed documents. Without prefixes, embedding quality degrades. Supported: search_query, search_document, classification, clustering. For LM Studio GGUF variant, prefixes are still required per model docs. In a RAG context: index notes as 'search_document: <note text>', embed queries as 'search_query: <query text>'.
